sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Short answers start with *igen* or *nem*. *És* (and) adds one idea to another and *de* (but) contrasts them. *Együtt* (together) says people or things are as one group, and with a plural subject the verb is *vannak*. The key word of an answer goes right before the verb: *Hol laksz? Budapesten lakom.*
*De* and *és* change the meaning completely: *Kicsi, de erős* (small, but strong) against *Kicsi és erős* (small and strong). Check which one you mean.
